title: Infrared Coercivity via Exact Mass Gap

tests.name: Dimensional consistency sweep (F3)
tests.finding: F3: μ_k should be [a⁻¹], not dimensionless
tests.diagnosis: CONFIRMED — Symbol Table lists μ_k as dimensionless, should be [a⁻¹]

tests.name: ℓ¹-norm bound Eq. (8.8) (F4)
tests.finding: F4: η_k^4 factor in Eq. (8.8) inconsistent with (8.7)
tests.diagnosis: γ grows as ln(μ·η) ≈ 23.57, not as μ·η ≈ 524288.00. Ratio γ/(c_μ·μ·η) = 0.0001. Linear approx INVALID at k=10.

tests.name: k_max at various β (F5)
tests.diagnosis: β=6: exact k_max=0, asymptotic≈20.7. Asymptotic valid only for β >> 60

tests.name: Legendre transform convexity (F6)
tests.finding: F6: Legendre transform needs justification for gauge theories
tests.diagnosis: Ĝ_c(ω) > 0 for all ω (min = 0.644780). Gauge zero modes must be removed before Legendre transform.

tests.name: Fourier-space bound validity range (F7)
tests.finding: F7: Bound valid only for small ω
tests.diagnosis: Bound valid for |ω| ≤ 0.931 (of π = 3.142). At ω=π: ratio = 0.420 (bound FAILS).

tests.name: Gauge-invariant vs gauge-fixed coercivity (F8)
tests.finding: F8: ||V_ℓ - 1||² is not gauge-invariant under different-site transforms
tests.diagnosis: Same-site gauge transform preserves ||V-1||²; different-site transform changes it by 43.0%.

tests.name: C_corr spectral upper bound (F9)
tests.finding: F9: C_corr bounded but not explicitly computed

tests.name: UV-IR matching precision (F10)
tests.finding: F10: Matching condition argued physically, not proven
tests.diagnosis: Non-perturbative matching errors are small at weak coupling but the argument is not rigorous.

tests.name: Gauge invariance of mass term (F12)
tests.finding: F12: Tr(A_μ A^μ) in Eq. (12.1) is gauge-non-invariant
tests.diagnosis: Physical mass gap (spectral gap) is gauge-invariant. Eq. (12.1) mass term Tr(A_μA^μ) is NOT gauge-invariant. Use spectral characterization instead.
